# Security policy

## Supported versions

Styr is currently experimental and does not yet publish a stable support matrix. Security fixes are applied to the current development line unless a release explicitly states otherwise.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a vulnerability that could expose users, firmware images, build infrastructure or contributor systems.

Preferred reporting order:

1. use GitHub private vulnerability reporting for the repository when available;
2. otherwise email `performer-nx@skjt.de` with the subject `Styr Security`.

Include the affected component, reproduction conditions, likely impact and any proposed mitigation. Please allow time for the report to be reproduced and fixed before public disclosure.

## Scope

Useful reports include vulnerabilities in the firmware, bootloader/update path, repository automation and first-party development tooling. Vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies should also be reported upstream when appropriate; Styr can then evaluate the pinned version and mitigation.
